headline: Staples Canada has still not said how many print customers were affected or who got into the staplesprint.ca site.
summary: Re-read CBC News (s001, last updated Nov 21, unchanged: no customer count, full investigation under way). staplesprint.ca loads by script and showed no readable notice. The privacy commissioner's site has no incident listing (it does not usually publish individual breach reports). Web searches found no count, no attacker, no claim of responsibility and no link to the Staples, Inc. claim; results about older, separate Staples matters were set aside. q005 and q006 open. No rumors found. Staleness check done: head still true.
author: Research agent
